Subject: Privacy intake for procurement — initial checklist

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for agreeing to support Helix Health as a potential customer. Procurement at Helix has asked us to collect a short privacy/onboarding packet before we proceed to PO and contracts. To keep the intake lightweight, can you send the following items by EOD Tuesday (US/PST)?

- Confirmation whether CloudMetric will sign Redwood's standard DPA (I can attach a draft) or whether you need your own.
- A current list of subprocessors (names, geographic region, purpose).
- High-level data retention defaults (logs, backups, customer PII, analytics) and any configurable retention windows.
- SOC2 or equivalent attestation (PDF or link) — if available.
- Any required contractual clauses (data localization, export controls, or special billing terms relevant to Helix).

For context: Helix runs in US-east and requires a PO before work begins; they prefer 12 month retention limits for backups unless otherwise justified. Ive attached the Helix procurement intake form for reference — well upload completed answers into their portal.

Attachments: Helix-Procurement-Form-blank.pdf (referenced)

Next steps: once we have the items above, Ill circulate to Legal and Privacy for review (cc'd: Laura and Marissa). If any of these items require a longer timeline, flag the expected ETA in your reply.

Appreciate it —

Jonas Weber

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and Ive attached two files: CloudMetric-Subprocessors-20260522.pdf and a DPA draft we typically use.

- DPA: CloudMetric is willing to sign Redwood's template DPA. We reviewed your standard and have only a couple of non-substantive comments (formatting and a clause about telemetry). If youd like, we can prepare a redline.
- Subprocessors: attached is our current list. Key third parties include: LabelWorks (data labeling, EU), S3-compatible storage (US-east, backups), TelemetryHub (operational metrics, US), and ModelOps Pty (model tuning, APAC). The attached PDF includes contact names and GDPR region mapping.
- Retention: defaults are as follows — operational logs: 180 days; backups: 365 days (encrypted, routine purge schedule); customer PII persisted only as required for support tickets and then purged after 90 days unless an extended retention is requested in writing. We can configure retention windows for Helix at the PO stage.
- Attestations: we completed SOC2 Type II in Q4 2025 — final report available under NDA (we can upload to your secure share).
- Contractual asks: none beyond standard security controls; we do request reasonable limits on liability tied to service usage.

ETA: I can get the signed DPA or redline within 3 business days and provide the SOC2 under NDA the same day.

Attachments: CloudMetric-Subprocessors-20260522.pdf (list), CloudMetric-DPA-draft-20260522.pdf (DPA draft)

Best,

Thanks for the ping, Jonas. Quick notes from Privacy:

- DPA: good to hear they will sign ours. Please obtain the redline if they provide one; Legal should confirm any non-standard liability language.
- Subprocessors: the attached list is acceptable in principle. Please ask for clarification on LabelWorks: what access do they have to raw PII and do they perform any human review or labeling? If human review, well want stricter contractual safeguards (limited access, approved subprocessor agreement, and logging).
- Retention: 90 days for PII and 365 for backups is OK for Helix if Helix explicitly approves. For Helix's procurement questionnaire, please state: backups encrypted at rest, daily snapshots, retention 365 days, restore-only access limited to CloudMetric ops and on written request.
- Controls: request explicit encryption-at-rest language and a statement that backups are stored in US-east for Helix unless otherwise requested. Also request confirmation that telemetry/analytics data can be excluded from Helix-specific datasets.

Ill draft suggested wording for the procurement form fields (short bullets) and upload to the Drive link you referenced. If Legal wants to push stronger clauses, flag them and Ill coordinate with the Helix security contact.

-Marissa
